text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, yes. I've indeed suffered a minor
injury...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh? But this is as minor as they come.
choice_data_list: That definitely doesn't feel like "just a little"!
That really doesn't feel like "just a little".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I hail from the Mejiro family, yes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
How am I to realize my ambitions if I
allow
something so trivial to impede my
progress?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
How am I to realize my ambitions if I
allow
something so trivial to impede my
progress?
choice_data_list: As a Trainer, I can't overlook this.
Should we bet on that feeling?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...I've seen them—the strong, who carry
on
through the hardest of times with
their heads held
high.
choice_data_list: As a Trainer, I can't overlook this.
Should we bet on that feeling?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
choice_data_list: Let's rest for now so we can keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, indeed. I wasn't quite thinking
straight for
a moment there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
How unbecoming of me. You have my
word that I
shall compensate for this
dishonorable blunder
through my
running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that in exchange, she has to
stop the
second something feels off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. Now then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why is it... that I can't seem to... move
forward?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Mejiro Bright's body was
closer to its
limit than she realized. I
hurriedly recommend
that she rest...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As I'm unable to move, I shall study to
ensure that
my next training session is
fruitful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This will be my routine for the time

being—recuperating while finding new
ways to
improve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Mejiros are known for turning even crises
into
opportunities, you see.
